name: Tao Chu Qinglong Shan
source:
You wake up suddenly and find yourself in a mental hospital, facing numerous severely mentally ill patients, with your life hanging by a thread. Can you escape from here?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2740190/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你突然醒来，发现自己身处精神病院，面对着无数的重度精神病患者，命悬一线。你能逃离这里吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2740190/]Steam[/url]]
